#### `TriggerBuffer is used so players can do a nice double tap and get two bullets out with confidence. This can be varied for weapons. Does it have a "trigger buffer" or not and is it activated (customization). A gun with a low fire rate and a fire buffer feels aqwuard, but its up to the player. We could also always trigger buffer could also be hidden and have a re-trigger requirement that is 75% of the fire rate or something like this, as to not miss trigger pulls that are close to refire but too early. Maybe the "fire buffer size" is a feature the gun can have, so short requirement and high buffer count means they can click 5 times and get 5 shots of super fast. This will then also sync since the weapon is set to fire 5 bullets in a row, just like a burst would be sent.` — `EdGraphNode_Comment` (`EdGraphNode_Comment_-1600_1136_18F6B703`)

- Position: (-1600, 1136)
- Node type: `Generic`
- Comment: TriggerBuffer is used so players can do a nice double tap and get two bullets out with confidence. This can be varied for weapons. Does it have a "trigger buffer" or not and is it activated (customization). A gun with a low fire rate and a fire buffer feels aqwuard, but its up to the player. We could also always trigger buffer could also be hidden and have a re-trigger requirement that is 75% of the fire rate or something like this, as to not miss trigger pulls that are close to refire but too early. Maybe the "fire buffer size" is a feature the gun can have, so short requirement and high buffer count means they can click 5 times and get 5 shots of super fast. This will then also sync since the weapon is set to fire 5 bullets in a row, just like a burst would be sent.
- Pins: _none_
